notes.title: The night of Walpurgis is upon us…
notes.content:
[h3]PLEASE NOTE: “The Ballad” is currently only available in Russian! We are currently working on the English translation and will make it available as soon as possible.
[/h3]
[img]https://sun9-13.userapi.com/impg/_KifjLJa3wi-3oZnzjsFnGHdQlaWXzveYeugqQ/lFulHjHKDWQ.jpg?size=2560x1162&quality=95&sign=7545ba8dbb60ed61ff37bb062e0efdfe&type=album[/img]
[h2]The first paid DLC for Young Hearts, “The Ballad of Blood, Mist, and Darkness,” will be available today![/h2]
The update also includes some bug fixes for some of the previously released routes.
